target: 30-40 real seconds in severe cold, faster in milder weather
conditions: Engine already running at idle; initial coolant and cabin equal outside temperature; heater 3; doors/windows closed; one occupant; endpoint cabin +15 C. Cranking/frozen-oil preheat excluded.
notes: Cold-range engine response 10 below 60 C, tapering to 0.2 at 80 C; hot and stopped response unchanged.
Cab heating response 12 with powered heater, running engine and positive temperature rate; same equilibrium, stable exponential step.
Existing off/low/unpowered heater, cold/stopped engine, windows, sleep, battery/fuel and hot-climb regressions pass.
No rendering or shader changes; no frame-time benchmark performed for this thermal tuning.
